title: Using a photocopier machine
competency: Use a photocopier machine step by step.

keywords.def: A copy of printed material made by light forming an image on an electrically charged surface.

en.text: A photocopy is a copy made by light forming an image on an electrically charged surface. Photocopying is a common small business for young people. To copy: 1 turn on the copier (check the plug, press power; if asleep press copy), 2 put the document face down on the glass along the guide marks, 3 select the number of copies, 4 adjust the colour, 5 select the paper size, 6 press copy or start.

am.text: ፎቶ ኮፒ ለማድረግ፡ ማሽኑን አብራ፣ ሰነዱን ወደ ታች አድርገህ በመስታወቱ ላይ አስቀምጥ፣ የቅጂ ብዛት ምረጥ፣ ቀለምና የወረቀት መጠን አስተካክል፣ "copy" ተጫን።

screens.title: A blank copy
screens.ask: Your document comes out blank. What is the most likely mistake?
opts: The document was placed face up instead of face down
screens.after: The front of the document must face down on the glass.

screens.title: Steps to use a photocopier
paras: 1. Turn on the photocopier: make sure the power cable is plugged in, then press the power button. If it is on but not responding, it may be in sleep mode: press "copy".
2. Put your document on the copier: lift the cover, place it face down on the glass following the guide marks, close the cover.
3. Select the number of copies with the display and the + and − keys.
4. Adjust the colour: menu → settings → colour preference → select colours → Save.
5. Select paper size: 8.5 × 11 inches is standard; special sizes go in the right tray.
